executive_summary: In highlight coverage, our World Cup prediction market analysis dominated earned media this week, with our $20 billion onchain volume report picked up across 10+ outlets including Reuters, BeInCrypto, TradingView, and CoinDesk in English, French, German, Japanese, and Korean editions—establishing thought leadership on institutional prediction market scale. Our Coldcard hardware wallet hack analysis generated 6 major placements (CryptoRank, Bitcoin World, Bitcoin News) tracking $30M stolen in minutes and Canadian holder exposure, cementing our forensics credibility amid accelerating self-custody security failures. Our privacy blockchain monitoring capabilities were featured in Digital Watch Observatory, signaling competitive differentiation as privacy coins challenge traditional compliance tools. In crypto news, Reuters broke that illicit Iranian gambling networks orchestrated a $4 billion sanctions evasion scheme, underscoring institutional-scale sanctions dodging; Circle's revenue miss spooked investors despite quarterly profitability (Reuters); and Chime's 10% workforce reduction on AI efficiency gains reflects broader fintech automation trends. In competitor news, Elliptic secured a $3.1M compliance transformation deal with a global crypto exchange; TRM Labs hired Claudia Hui (former MAS regulator) for APAC expansion; Arkham pivoted to full exchange decentralization and tracked major Bitcoin transfers; and Solidus Labs landed Kinetic Markets and Kalshi deals amid $31B monthly volume.

market_landscape.title: Institutional Prediction Markets Normalize
market_landscape.body: The $20B World Cup onchain volume establishes prediction markets as mainstream institutional infrastructure rather than speculative edge case. Regulatory attention will follow as US, China, and EU clarify derivatives rules around decentralized markets.

market_landscape.title: Hardware Wallet Threat Surface Expands
market_landscape.body: Coldcard exploits and $30M minute-scale theft demonstrate supply-chain and firmware risks in self-custody—accelerating institutional migration to TradFi-backed custodians and exchange wallets. Compliance teams need real-time forensics on stolen fund flows.

market_landscape.title: Privacy-Compliance Tension Hardens
market_landscape.body: Privacy blockchains challenge traditional monitoring tooling, forcing regulators and compliance vendors into architectural choices. Expect emerging market adoption of privacy coins to intensify regulatory crackdowns and create compliance blind spots.
